# External research references

These directories preserve source attribution, links and this project's own post-competition analysis. Full third-party articles, translations, raw PDF text exports and copied figures have been replaced with short reference pages. No third-party redistribution permission is implied.

Historical `README.md`, `source_index.md` and link-following notes describe what was inspected during the original research. Their references to a full local article, raw export or figure are historical records; those copies are not included in this distribution. Read the publisher's page for the original material. `analysis/` files remain unchanged.
